text: Spaces of a deleted account pass to a manager or writer instead of going with the account
description: Raised by Claude 2026-11-20 after building account deletion; Felix: low priority. Today discarding an account (30 days after deletion, or an idle automatic account) removes the spaces it owns, also when others manage or write in them. 10c6b4a7 had noted the same choice for automatic accounts ("assumed they still go"). Proposed: hand each such space to a manager, else a writer (longest in the space first); only a space nobody else is in goes.

status.comment: 2026-11-22: auth/discard.ts heirOf picks a manager, else a writer, the one added first (list order = join order; there is no join date); discardAccount makes the heir owner and takes them out of the writer/manager lists before removing the rest. Only owned spaces nobody else is in go (with their offers); deleted spaces in the trash still go. ownFootprint now returns passedOn next to spaces, and the discard dialog (LoginControl.vue) says 'Others are in X: it passes to them.' Evidence: discard.test.ts new case (Garden → first writer, Bakery → manager before writer, Alone removed, offer of the passed-on space removed as Ben's own note), discard/read-access/account-deletion 12/12, LoginControl.spec 9/9, tsc + vue-tsc clean. Not changed: a remote space's push key stays the gone account's key until the new owner picks another.
